F-GC20.use: Exact qualified tile aggregation production source is inherited and aggregate_groundwater_cell_tiles is called by GC25 topology validation and predictor/corrector aggregation.

F-GC21.use: Single-tile predictor/corrector semantics and equivalence fixture; GC25 preserves the established interface transaction semantics while composing multiple tiles before publication.

F-GC22.use: Exact qualified accuracy-binding production source is inherited. GC25 consumes a pre-bound groundwater_head_convergence_policy_t; application-to-policy construction remains upstream and is not re-owned or requalified by GC25.

F-GC24.use: Coupled restart/replay remains unchanged by this capability.

qualified_contract.cell_transaction: All participating direct-coupled SWAP tile candidates, the one groundwater candidate and all tile mass-ledger publications are recoverably prepared and globally preflighted before first publication.
qualified_contract.failure_atomicity: A failing predictor/corrector tile or groundwater trial rejects the cell window without publishing another participant in that cell.
qualified_contract.multicell_isolation: A later failing groundwater cell executed on the same reused worker/executor does not mutate a previously accepted cell and does not publish its own SWAP, groundwater or ledger state.
qualified_contract.aggregation: Accepted tile transfer is aggregated deterministically using the qualified F-GC20 area-fraction primitive in canonical tile-id order.
qualified_contract.mass_provenance: One interface ledger remains bound to each real SWAP tile lineage; each ledger receives the area-weighted accepted tile transfer and the groundwater service receives only the aggregate cell exchange.
qualified_contract.bounded_cost: Restricted two-phase composition performs at most predictor plus one corrector SWAP trajectory per participating tile and one groundwater trial per phase; the qualification test observes exactly four SWAP trajectories for a two-tile cell and eight for two sequential two-tile cells on one reused worker.
qualified_contract.solver_ownership: No heavy solver object is added per logical column; GC25 receives and reuses the existing worker-local kernel_executor_t.
qualified_contract.external_adapter_boundary: No MODFLOW type, file IO or concrete external groundwater backend dependency is introduced.
